### Sales {#type-commerz-sales-sales}

`Commerz\Sales\Sales`

Root of the sales API: accessors of the module contracts. A module is resolved when it is first asked for, so the ports one module needs (the stock of the checkout, say) are not required by a host that uses only another one.

```php
final readonly class Sales {
    __construct(\Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container $container);
    carts(): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Contracts\Carts;
    checkout(): \Commerz\Sales\Checkout\Contracts\Checkout;
    fulfillments(): \Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Contracts\Fulfillments;
    orders(): \Commerz\Sales\Orders\Contracts\Orders;
    payments(): \Commerz\Sales\Payments\Contracts\Payments;
    refunds(): \Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Contracts\Refunds;
    returns(): \Commerz\Sales\Returns\Contracts\Returns;
}
```

### Carts {#type-commerz-sales-carts-contracts-carts}

`Commerz\Sales\Carts\Contracts\Carts`

Carts, and the drafts of a CRM, which are carts of kind `draft`. A cart sells in the channel, currency and locale it was created with; every change moves its `version` on, and a converted cart is no longer changed.

```php
interface Carts {
    addLine(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\AddCartLine $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    clearDelivery(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\ClearDelivery $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    create(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CreateCart $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    // The delivery methods that serve the cart's shipping address for the goods that ship; none when no line ships.
    deliveryOptions(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartId $id): array;
    // A code already entered changes nothing. @throws CartNotFound|CartNotOpen
    enterCode(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\EnterCode $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    find(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartId $id): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    list(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\ListCarts $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Prices the cart now: the one calculation the placement of the order checks its total against. An empty cart quotes to zero.
    quote(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartId $id): \Commerz\Quotes\Data\QuoteResult;
    // A code that was not entered changes nothing. @throws CartNotFound|CartNotOpen
    removeCode(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\RemoveCode $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    removeLine(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\RemoveCartLine $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    selectDelivery(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\SelectDelivery $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    setAddress(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\SetCartAddress $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    setCustomer(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\SetCartCustomer $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    setLineQuantity(\Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\SetCartLineQuantity $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
}
```

### Checkout {#type-commerz-sales-checkout-contracts-checkout}

`Commerz\Sales\Checkout\Contracts\Checkout`

Turns a cart into an order.

```php
interface Checkout {
    // Places the cart in one transaction (ORD-01, ORD-02): the snapshot of its quote becomes the order with a number, the physical lines are reserved without a deadline, the applied promotions are counted and the cart is converted. Any failure leaves nothing behind. A cart becomes at most one order: a repeat with the same idempotency key returns that order, a repeat without one fails with `CartAlreadyPlaced`. Payment is a separate command.
    place(\Commerz\Sales\Checkout\Data\PlaceOrder $command): \Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\OrderView;
}
```

### PlaceOrder {#type-commerz-sales-checkout-data-placeorder}

`Commerz\Sales\Checkout\Data\PlaceOrder`

Places the cart as an order. `$expectedTotal` is the total the buyer accepted (`Carts::quote`); the order is placed only at that total. With an idempotency key a repeated request returns the same order.

```php

    public readonly ?\Commerz\Identity\ActorRef $actor;

}
```

### Fulfillments {#type-commerz-sales-fulfillments-contracts-fulfillments}

`Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Contracts\Fulfillments`

Fulfillments of orders (ORD-03, D14): what left the warehouse, and with whom. Units are fulfilled once (the ledger of the order line), stock is consumed in the same transaction, and a carrier is booked outside any transaction.

```php
interface Fulfillments {
    // Books the shipment with the carrier of the order's delivery and ships the fulfillment with the carrier's answer. Must be called outside any database transaction. The booking is idempotent at the shipping package by the reference `fulfillment:{id}`, so a repeat after a lost answer is safe. An already booked fulfillment or a manual shipment with no booking intent is returned without a call. An in-flight booking overtaken by a manual shipment is recovered by that same reference, and a conflicting answer is reported on every retry with the booked shipment (including its label) in the exception. Retry with the same dimensions and meta.
    book(\Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\BookFulfillment $command): \Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\FulfillmentView;
    // Fulfils units of a placed order and consumes the held stock of its physical lines; services and digital goods leave the stock alone. A repeat with the same idempotency key returns the same document.
    create(\Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\CreateFulfillment $command): \Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\FulfillmentView;
    find(\Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\FulfillmentId $id): \Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\FulfillmentView;
    list(\Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\ListFulfillments $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    markDelivered(\Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\MarkFulfillmentDelivered $command): \Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\FulfillmentView;
    // Marks the fulfillment shipped. Shipping it again with the same carrier and tracking returns it unchanged.
    ship(\Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\ShipFulfillment $command): \Commerz\Sales\Fulfillments\Data\FulfillmentView;
}
```

### PaymentGateway {#type-commerz-sales-gateways-contracts-paymentgateway}

`Commerz\Sales\Gateways\Contracts\PaymentGateway`

A payment gateway, a contribution of kind `payment_gateway`. Called only by sales and only outside a database transaction.

```php
interface PaymentGateway {
    const KIND = 'payment_gateway';
    // Reconciles an unknown outcome with the provider's current state.
    find(string $reference): ?\Commerz\Sales\Gateways\Data\GatewayPaymentResult;
    findRefund(string $reference): ?\Commerz\Sales\Gateways\Data\GatewayRefundResult;
    // Idempotent by `$request->reference` at the provider: the adapter passes it as the idempotency key or metadata.
    initiate(\Commerz\Sales\Gateways\Data\GatewayPaymentRequest $request): \Commerz\Sales\Gateways\Data\GatewayPaymentResult;
    // Contribution key, e.g. `manual` or `acme.pay`.
    key(): string;
    // Idempotent by `$request->reference`.
    refund(\Commerz\Sales\Gateways\Data\GatewayRefundRequest $request): \Commerz\Sales\Gateways\Data\GatewayRefundResult;
}
```

### Orders {#type-commerz-sales-orders-contracts-orders}

`Commerz\Sales\Orders\Contracts\Orders`

Placed orders, and the drafts an operator assembles before placing them.

```php
interface Orders {
    // Cancels every unit of the order: releases its stock, gives its promotion usage back as the promotions' policy allows, and records `sales.order_cancelled`. A paid order also records `sales.payment_requires_refund`; nothing is refunded automatically. Cancelling a cancelled order changes nothing.
    cancel(\Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\CancelOrder $command): \Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\OrderView;
    // Cancels units of some lines of a placed order and releases their stock; the amount due shrinks by their exact share of the line totals, delivery stays. Cancelling every unit left is `cancel`; cancelling the rest of a fulfilled and paid order completes it.
    cancelLines(\Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\CancelOrderLines $command): \Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\OrderView;
    // Opens a draft (D31): a cart of kind `draft` with the lines, codes, addresses and delivery method of the command, edited further with `Carts` and placed with `Checkout::place`. A draft has no payment deadline.
    draft(\Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\DraftOrder $command): \Commerz\Sales\Carts\Data\CartView;
    // Cancels, with the reason `expired`, the unpaid orders whose payment deadline has passed (D32). An order with a payment under way, a captured payment or a fulfilled unit stays; drafts have no deadline. Safe to run in parallel.
    expireDue(\Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\ExpireOrders $command): \Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\ExpireReport;
    find(\Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\OrderId $id): \Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\OrderView;
    findByNumber(\Commerz\Stores\Data\StoreId $store, string $number): \Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\OrderView;
    // The history of the order, oldest first.
    history(\Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\OrderId $id): array;
    list(\Commerz\Sales\Orders\Data\ListOrders $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
}
```

### Payments {#type-commerz-sales-payments-contracts-payments}

`Commerz\Sales\Payments\Contracts\Payments`

Payments of orders at payment gateways (PAY-01, PAY-02, D33). An attempt is written before the gateway is called, the gateway is called outside any database transaction, and an answer that is not certain leaves the attempt `unknown` until `reconcile` asks the gateway. Money is never captured twice: provider events are recorded once per id, and the status of a payment only moves forward.

```php
interface Payments {
    find(\Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\PaymentId $id): \Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\PaymentView;
    // Starts a payment attempt at the gateway; must be called outside any database transaction. A repeat with the same idempotency key returns the attempt as it is now, without calling the gateway again.
    initiate(\Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\InitiatePayment $command): \Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\PaymentView;
    list(\Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\ListPayments $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Asks the gateway the payment was made at what became of it; must be called outside any database transaction. An attempt the provider never saw becomes `failed`; a final payment is returned without calling the gateway.
    reconcile(\Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\ReconcilePayment $command): \Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\PaymentView;
    // Records an event of the provider once per `(gateway, externalEventId)` and moves the payment forward; an event that would move it back is kept as `ignored`. Money captured on a cancelled order is kept, and the order records `sales.payment_requires_refund`.
    recordEvent(\Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\RecordPaymentEvent $command): \Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\PaymentEventResult;
}
```

### RecordPaymentEvent {#type-commerz-sales-payments-data-recordpaymentevent}

`Commerz\Sales\Payments\Data\RecordPaymentEvent`

An event of a provider about a payment (PAY-01), recorded once per `(gateway, externalEventId)`. The adapter passes the provider's event id, or a semantic key where it has none (`payment.succeeded:{object.id}` for YooKassa, `eventCode:pspReference` for Adyen). The payment is found by our `paymentReference` (`payment:{id}`) or by the provider's `externalPaymentId`; at least one is required, and both may be given.

```php

    public readonly ?\Commerz\Money\Money $amount;
    public readonly string $externalEventId;
    public readonly ?string $externalPaymentId;
    public readonly string $gateway;
    public readonly ?\DateTimeImmutable $occurredAt;
    public readonly array $payload;
    public readonly ?string $paymentReference;
    public readonly \Commerz\Sales\Payments\Enums\PaymentEventType $type;
    __construct(string $gateway, string $externalEventId, \Commerz\Sales\Payments\Enums\PaymentEventType $type, ?string $paymentReference = null, ?string $externalPaymentId = null, ?\Commerz\Money\Money $amount = null, ?\DateTimeImmutable $occurredAt = null, array $payload = []);
}
```

### PaymentStatus {#type-commerz-sales-payments-enums-paymentstatus}

`Commerz\Sales\Payments\Enums\PaymentStatus`

The status of one payment attempt (D33). `initiating` while the gateway is being asked, `unknown` when its answer was lost (reconcile it); `failed` and `cancelled` are final, though money that arrives later is still `captured`.

```php
enum PaymentStatus {
    case Initiating = 'initiating';
    case Pending = 'pending';
    case RequiresAction = 'requires_action';
    case Authorized = 'authorized';
    case Captured = 'captured';
    case Failed = 'failed';
    case Cancelled = 'cancelled';
    case Unknown = 'unknown';
    // Captured, failed or cancelled: the gateway has nothing more to tell.
    isFinal(): bool;
}
```

### Refunds {#type-commerz-sales-refunds-contracts-refunds}

`Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Contracts\Refunds`

Money given back through the gateway of a captured payment (REF-01, D33): the same journal as payments — the attempt is written before the gateway is called, the gateway is called outside any database transaction, and an answer that is not certain leaves the refund `unknown` until `reconcile`. Never more than a payment captured goes back, and a refund never touches the stock: goods come back only through `Returns::receive`.

```php
interface Refunds {
    find(\Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\RefundId $id): \Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\RefundView;
    // Refunds an amount of an order through the gateway of one payment; must be called outside any database transaction. A repeat with the same idempotency key returns the refund as it is now, without calling the gateway again. A refund that leaves the order fully refunded gives its promotion usage back (`refunded`, as the promotions' `restore_on` policy allows).
    issue(\Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\IssueRefund $command): \Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\RefundView;
    list(\Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\ListRefunds $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Asks the gateway the refund was made at what became of it; must be called outside any database transaction. A refund the provider never saw becomes `failed`; a final refund is returned without calling the gateway.
    reconcile(\Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\ReconcileRefund $command): \Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\RefundView;
    // Records an event of the provider about a refund once per `(gateway, externalEventId)`. A succeeded refund keeps its status and the event is kept as `ignored`; a failed one still takes a success, unless its amount was refunded again meanwhile (the order journals `refund_over_refunded`).
    recordEvent(\Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\RecordRefundEvent $command): \Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\RefundEventResult;
}
```

`Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Data\RecordRefundEvent`

An event of a provider about a refund, recorded once per `(gateway, externalEventId)` in the same inbox as payment events (PAY-01). The refund is found by our `refundReference` (`refund:{id}`) or by the provider's `externalRefundId`; at least one is required, and both may be given.

### RefundStatus {#type-commerz-sales-refunds-enums-refundstatus}

`Commerz\Sales\Refunds\Enums\RefundStatus`

The status of one refund attempt (D33). `initiating` while the gateway is being asked, `pending` while the provider works on it, `unknown` when its answer was lost (reconcile it). `succeeded` is final; `failed` frees the amount and the gateway is not asked again, though a later success from the provider still settles it.

```php
enum RefundStatus {
    case Initiating = 'initiating';
    case Pending = 'pending';
    case Succeeded = 'succeeded';
    case Failed = 'failed';
    case Unknown = 'unknown';
    // Succeeded or failed: reconcile has nothing to ask the gateway.
    isFinal(): bool;
}
```

### Returns {#type-commerz-sales-returns-contracts-returns}

`Commerz\Sales\Returns\Contracts\Returns`

Returns of fulfilled goods (REF-01). A request only reserves the units against further returns; accepting the goods counts them as returned, and only an explicit restock puts units back on hand.

```php
interface Returns {
    // Withdraws a requested return. Cancelling a cancelled return changes nothing.
    cancel(\Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\CancelReturn $command): \Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\ReturnView;
    find(\Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\ReturnId $id): \Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\ReturnView;
    list(\Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\ListReturns $query): \Commerz\Pagination\Page;
    // Accepts the goods: the units count as returned, and the physical ones listed in `restock` go back on hand under the reference `return:{id}`. Receiving a received return changes nothing.
    receive(\Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\ReceiveReturn $command): \Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\ReturnView;
    // Opens a return of fulfilled units not yet returned and not held by another open return. A repeat with the same idempotency key returns the same document.
    request(\Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\RequestReturn $command): \Commerz\Sales\Returns\Data\ReturnView;
}
```
